headlines.title: Filmed in Captivity: Inside Russia’s Prison Propaganda Machine
headlines.description: Russian captors force Ukrainian prisoners of war to record propaganda videos designed to rally domestic support for the invasion and sow division within Ukraine. The videos often haunt former captives long after their release. NBC News’ Jane Lytvynenko travels to Ukraine to uncover how this propaganda influences local communities and the lives of returning soldiers.

headlines.title: U.S. military leaders divided over action against the Houthis
headlines.description: WASHINGTON — U.S. military leaders are divided on whether President Donald Trump should get involved with the conflict between Saudi Arabia and Iranian-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen, according to two U.S. officials.

headlines.title: Trump to address the United Nations General Assembly as Iran war rumbles on
headlines.description: President Donald Trump will deliver a speech to the United Nations General Assembly in New York City on Tuesday.

headlines.title: No criminal charges in death of Nolan Wells, grand jury finds
headlines.description: A grand jury will not pursue criminal charges in the death of Nolan Wells, the local district attorney said, forcefully rejecting months of speculation that race played a role in the death of the Mississippi teen this summer.

headlines.title: ICE officer shoots delivery driver in Texas
headlines.description: A 28-year-old man was shot and wounded in his car in Austin by an ICE officer. New video shows the chaotic moments. NBC News’ Ryan Chandler has the story.

headlines.title: Three media outlets sue over Trump WH ban
headlines.description: CNN, MS Now and Politico have sued after President Trump revoked their access to the White House for what he called one-sided coverage of the administration. NBC News’ Kelly O’Donnell reports.

headlines.title: ‘Looksmaxxing’ influencer Clavicular charged with rape in Massachusetts
headlines.description: The “looksmaxxing” personality known as Clavicular has been charged with rape in Massachusetts, online court records show.

headlines.title: These young quarterbacks were supposed to break out. Now they’re hurt.
headlines.description: The New York Giants’ Jaxson Dart on Monday became the latest upstart QB to be sidelined with an injury, joining the Bears’ Caleb Williams and the Commanders’ Jayden Daniels as signal callers who had to leave the field early in Week 2.

headlines.title: Drinking finally slows after pandemic spike, but not for every age group
headlines.description: Americans are drinking less for the first time since the pandemic, but alcohol use remains higher than it was before 2020, according to a study published Monday in the journal Annals of Internal Medicine.

headlines.title: What might an AI doomsday look like? Experts have given it some thought
headlines.description: A small but dedicated group of AI experts has been warning for years that increasingly powerful AI systems could cause catastrophic damage or even lead to human extinction.

headlines.title: Texas college quarterback apologizes for comments about violent AI video
headlines.description: Texas Longhorns quarterback Arch Manning apologized for referencing an AI video showing his coach slapping ESPN sideline reporter Holly Rowe. “In my press conference yesterday, I made an insensitive comment about an AI video. There is nothing funny about it,” Manning wrote.

headlines.title: Inside Russia’s industry of forced POW videos
headlines.description: Russia has coerced thousands of Ukrainian prisoners to denounce their leaders and country in propaganda videos. The consequences can follow them home.
